summary_1line: Rama asks Vishwamitra how to recall divine weapons, and the sage teaches the mantras and grants him many additional mystical arms.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the forest, sage Vishwamitra stands before Rama and Lakshmana, teaching sacred mantras as invisible celestial weapons are bestowed upon the prince.
Rama stands with folded hands while radiant spirit-forms of divine weapons gather around him awaiting his command.
